title: F15 — Realtime progress and verification
tagline: an observation-only channel tells the app what the server has confirmed; a worker re-reads every object and flips it to verified or mismatch.
intro: Sprint S8 · 21h · skeleton guide — full code is added when this feature starts.
Code in this guide is a teaching example. Check current source and follow F00 localization rules before applying it.

blocks.html:
• Goal: an observation-only channel tells the app what the server has confirmed; a worker re-reads every object and flips it to verified or mismatch.
  • Demo — offline: no channel: the Sync tab is only slower, never red.
  • Demo — signed in: uploads turn “verified” as events arrive; a tampered object shows as a mismatch; /verify shows the new state.
  • Spec: 10 Realtime channel, 03-backend §9
  • Starts from: F06–F07 (upload store) and F10 (/verify).
  • Steps: How every feature runs. Local is —: events only move existing upload jobs forward.
